entries.reachability_signal: help() output or inspect.signature() output shows 'initial=functools._initial_missing' instead of 'initial=<unrepresentable>'
entries.expected_signal: After-patch output shows meaningful initial parameter default; before-patch output shows unrepresentable or raises error
entries.input_strategy: Call help(functools.reduce) and inspect.signature(functools.reduce) on both before and after builds, comparing docstring output and signature parameter defaults
entries.limitations: Requires building CPython from source twice (before and after patch). Full build may take 5-10 minutes per version. Python developer dependencies (gcc, make, autoconf, pkg-config, zlib-dev, libffi-dev, etc.) must be installed.
